newsitem.title: USA: Northern Trust non-interest income up.
newsitem.headline: Northern Trust non-interest income up.

text.p: Northern Trust Corp said Tuesday non-interest income rose to $194.3 million in the third quarter from $173.4 million a year ago.

The bulk of the increase came from trust fees, which rose to $147.7 million in the quarter from $127.3 million a year ago. This gain was offset slightly by a drop in foreign exchange trading profits to $15.1 million from $16.2 million a year ago.

The $21.36 billion asset bank's provision for loan losses rose to $2.5 million in the quarter from $2.0 million a year ago in light of charge-offs in its commercial portfolio, Northern Trust said in a news release.
Nonperforming assets at September 30 were $37.7 million, up from $25.4 million a year ago, but down from $40.5 million at the end of the second quarter, Northern Trust said.

Return on average common equity was 18.93 percent in the quarter, up from 18.11 percent a year ago, and return on average assets was 1.26 percent, up from 1.14 percent a year ago, Northern Trust said.
Earlier Tuesday, Northern Trust reported net income of $66.5 million, or $1.14 a share, compared to $58.1 million, or $0.99 a share a year ago. The stock was up 3/4 at 66-3/4.
